name: auto-model-router
description: A transparent, boundary-gated policy that routes each coding-agent task to the lightest sufficient model or effort tier (fast, standard, reasoning, or max).

interface.shortDescription: Auto-continue clear fast work; confirm spendy and high-risk tiers.
interface.longDescription: Loads the portable auto-model-router skill: classify each task as fast, standard, reasoning, or max, show the suggestion, auto-continue only clear reversible fast work, and wait for confirmation on spendy or high-risk work. Does not change vendor billing APIs or guarantee savings.
